about: Curated early-career programs relevant to first- and second-year EE/CE students. Every entry was checked on its official page on verified_on; facts not shown on that page are not stated here. Programs whose official page could not be loaded or did not state eligibility and timing were left out.

programs.name: Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internships (SULI)
programs.org: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science (Workforce Development for Teachers and Scientists)
programs.eligibility: Undergraduate students and recent graduates majoring in a STEM field or science policy. The official page lists the full eligibility rules.
programs.class_year_note: The page does not set a minimum class year.
programs.deadline_text: Spring 2027 term: September 30, 2026, 5:00 p.m. ET. Fall 2026 applications are closed.
programs.format: 10-week summer internship (May to August) or a semester (August to December, or January to May).
programs.source_quote: SULI Program is now open for applications for the Spring 2027 Term.

programs.name: Community College Internships (CCI)
programs.org: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science (Workforce Development for Teachers and Scientists)
programs.eligibility: Community college students. The official page links to the detailed eligibility requirements.
programs.class_year_note: For students enrolled at community colleges.
programs.deadline_text: Spring 2027 term: September 30, 2026, 5:00 p.m. ET. Fall 2026 applications are closed.
programs.format: Internship managed by the DOE Office of Science.
programs.source_quote: Applications are due September 30, 2026 at 5:00pm ET

programs.name: NASA OSTEM Internships
programs.eligibility: U.S. citizens, at least 16 years old, with at least a 3.0/4.0 GPA, enrolled full or part time in college (undergraduate through graduate). STEM and non-STEM majors.
programs.class_year_note: No minimum class year is stated. NASA also lists Pathways Internships (U.S. citizens, 2.9 GPA, at least 15 semester hours completed), applied for through USAJOBS.
programs.deadline_text: Summer 2027: February 26, 2027. Fall 2027: May 21, 2027 (11:59 p.m. ET). The Spring 2027 deadline was September 14, 2026.
programs.format: Spring, summer and fall sessions. Applications go through the NASA STEM Gateway.
programs.pay: Most interns receive a stipend based on academic level and session length.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
programs.org: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
programs.eligibility: Full-time undergraduates at accredited two- or four-year U.S. colleges who are U.S. citizens or U.S. permanent residents and at least 18 years old. First-year undergraduates and graduating seniors are eligible.
programs.class_year_note: The page states that first-year undergraduates are eligible.

deadlines.note: end of January 2027; exact date not yet posted

programs.deadline_text: Applications are due at the end of January 2027. NIST expects the USAJOBS vacancy announcement to open in mid-October 2026.
programs.pay: 2026 stipend: $7,810 for 11 weeks ($710 per week), with limited housing and travel support for students who relocate.
programs.source_quote: First-year undergraduates and graduating seniors ... are eligible

programs.name: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU) Sites
programs.eligibility: Undergraduates who are U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals or U.S. permanent residents. The NSF page does not restrict by class year; each site runs its own selection.
programs.class_year_note: Individual sites may prefer certain years; read each site's page.
programs.deadline_text: Set by each REU site. Students apply to sites directly, not to NSF; use the NSF search to find electrical and computer engineering sites.
programs.format: Summer research at a university or lab site funded by NSF.
programs.pay: See each site's page for stipend and housing details.
programs.source_quote: Students follow the instructions provided by each REU Site or REU Supplement to apply.

programs.name: Sandia National Laboratories internships and co-ops
programs.org: Sandia National Laboratories (operated for the U.S. Department of Energy)
programs.eligibility: At least 16 years old and enrolled full time (typically 12 units for undergraduates) at an accredited college, university or high school. Minimum 3.0/4.0 GPA for R&D, technical and business positions. U.S. citizenship for positions that require a security clearance or where the posting says so.
programs.class_year_note: No minimum class year is stated.
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline on the page: apply to current openings. Summer internships run 10 to 12 weeks (typically May to August); co-ops run 3 to 8 months during the academic year.
programs.format: Summer internships, co-ops and year-round internships for local students, plus themed intern institutes.
programs.pay: Paid; the rate depends on credit hours, classification and degree level.
programs.source_quote: U.S. citizenship for positions that require security clearance or as stated in the job posting

programs.name: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory student internships
programs.eligibility: Community college, undergraduate and graduate students. International students can be eligible; visa sponsorship support varies by position. Selected students complete a federal background check and drug screen.
programs.class_year_note: No minimum class year is stated.
programs.deadline_text: Summer positions are generally posted September through February; phone interviews happen December through April.
programs.format: Science and engineering internships through internal and external programs.
programs.pay: Not stated on the page we checked.
programs.source_quote: Internships for summer positions are generally posted September–February
